title: Stale BG number on Always On Display
symptom: The BG number shown on the Always On Display is often stale, showing a reading from 15 minutes prior or even older, while the current BG is different. The issue occurs on LG devices with Android 8.0.0.
evidence_quote: The BG number that shows on the Always On Display will often be stale. In attached images, the current BG is 158. Always On Display shows 144, which is from 15 minutes prior.
